//: Typechecks the test files, which the build config deliberately excludes.
`tsconfig.json` sets rootDir/outDir and emits declarations, so a test left in its
`include` compiles into `dist/`. Excluding them is right — but it meant `expectTypeOf`
assertions were never checked by anything: `expectTypeOf` is erased at runtime, so a
type-level assertion in an untypechecked file passes unconditionally. P1-06 found this
by writing `z.infer` with no `z` in scope and watching `tsc -b` succeed.
That matters here more than anywhere: this package's whole contract is that the Zod
schemas and the hand-written interfaces in `types/` describe the same shape, and the
only thing asserting it is `expectTypeOf`. This config is what makes that assertion
real. It emits nothing; it exists to fail.
